pushed.description: Ids of KB entries the engine delivered to a dispatch (the pushed KNOWLEDGE BANK block). Each is recorded as one returned event; duplicates in the list count once.

cited.description: Ids of KB entries a role reported it actually used (kb_used). Each is recorded as one cited event; duplicates in the list count once.
